gaps.claim: paper.buy raises SystemExit on a refusal after the room is opened with a criterion; the room is left with no position, linked (never retried), and later answers in the call are skipped.
an answer naming more than rooms.MAX_LEGS (8) cards: set_plan raises after open_strategy wrote the room, leaving a room with no plan and no criterion, linked for good.

the question row is appended before the POST and only transport errors become a give-up; any other exception leaves a dangling question that lab.outstanding reads as in flight, blocking every ask for 24 h.
a queued or erroring deep job that never resolves keeps the question in flight until POLLABLE_HOURS (24 h), and may_ask_now refuses every new question meanwhile.
the 'Nexus: X of the last N answered' deep-lane health line reads _nexus_rows(), which now includes the sync door's always-immediate answers.
every UUID in an answer is treated as a card; a bot, job or position id 404s and is recorded as unknown_card with a held line blaming #91-style invention.
signals whose depth was never read (tradeable() None) are counted under excluded['untradeable'].
a token hot earlier in the same hour can be drawn into the control group later that hour.
`bought` dedups within one call only; a later tick can launch a second room on a card already held.
the search bite is removed from the queue before the door runs; a raising door drops the unwalked moves.
deep questions refused at capacity count against the 24-a-day cap though may_ask_now treats them as having spent nothing.
duplicates scripts/lab.py::_amount.
copies load and _append line for line.
the hasattr(load_all) fallback exists only for a test stub.
builds a new HTTP client per card per call.

if they reword the ask_nexus_deep window so the N-M minute regex finds nothing ('up to 15 minutes'), this check is inconclusive and #86 carries on with (1, 5) -- a 7-minute answer goes to their tracker as a FAIL. Sends a false claim.

asserts the journal does not contain the literal '"text": "@EventTraderQABot' with a space, but the journal is written compact (qa/state.py separators), so that string never occurs; a cmd_sent that prepended the handle would pass.
lenient count 0 while git's strict count is >0 reads inconclusive, though strict>0 proves git answered and lenient=0 can only mean the reader broke.
the quiet cases assert no line contains 'koreluje' and 'korelac', but the real line reads 'Kniha je moc korelovana (N_eff ...)' and contains neither; dropping the threshold to 0 stays green.
the fixture has is_error unset, so it is dropped by the is_error gate before the pytest-banner check runs; a real pytest exit 1 has is_error set and trail() returns it as 'error'.
a `next` entry is matched by its first 40 characters against any NEXT.md item, open or ticked; a short entry or one sharing a prefix with an old ticked line passes while nothing new is handed over.
a second reveal written as mark.hidden = !showAll, removeAttribute('hidden') or toggleAttribute matches neither pattern and passes (hypothetical).
calls pytest.skip but the file never imports pytest; with no memory index it fails with NameError instead of skipping.
the fixture's answers are already in ranked order (earliest is best earner), so a board() that drops its final sort passes.

every earlier room is stamped within the last hour, so a rooms_within that ignored `hours` and counted every room ever passes -- and the loop would stop opening rooms for good after its tenth. Same fixture shape in test_pipeline_night_spend.py's room-cap test.
proves the control pick is deterministic, not that it is by hash; a pick_control taking the first N non-hot rows in their order passes.
a calibration block is counted unchanged when every field of the NEW block equals the stored row (one-direction subset); a version that drops a field is never written; the test only moves a value.

'backtest' is in every room's why (the 'Backtest: ...' clause), so removing the conditional 'NOT backtested -- half stake' clause stays green; the stake assertion is an upper bound only, so a quarter stake or a cent also passes.
'never a proposal' is the fixed section header and the register fixture is empty, so a brief listing our baskets as buy recommendations under that header passes.
'the tick asks nothing' is asserted by a dict key name; a door under another key, or a direct nexus.ask call inside tick(), passes.
tests proposed_cards' known/unknown split, which its only production caller no longer uses (known=()); the 404 branch in night_promote is what stops the buy, and deleting it leaves this test green.

since today the lab polls with poll_once, which returns before GIVE_UP_SECONDS, so a question that stays queued never gets a finishing row; queued questions never enter the last-5 window and #86 can PASS on the five before them; the stalled reason says 'still running' when the status was queued.
passes only on a whitelisted key whose value parses as days or an ISO date; their house style ('19.8 days', '48h', a {start,end} block, days_covered: 119) reads None, so a correct fix FAILS.
any non-empty value under a window-ish key passes, e.g. period: {start: null, end: null}, or bar-size keys interval: '1h' / timeframe: '1d'.
methods in Allow are recorded but never compared with the documented ones; an undocumented PATCH beside a documented DELETE passes (not live today).

breaches() skips any hot row with max_buy None; a hot row with max_buy_5pct_usd null and liquidity_usd null breaks their own words ('an unreadable reserve fails closed to not-hot') and decide() still passes.

fails on >66% anonymous among ALL rows with conviction (filter=all), never reading `hot`; 17 of 40 hot all anonymous with the cold named gives 0.43 and PASS. The FAIL reason says 'the feed says it has nothing left to resolve' when their pending counter says otherwise.
the docstring accepts three repairs; the assertion passes only on six named deadline fields -- repair 2 is invisible (FAIL), repair 1 is inconclusive, a deadline under another name FAILS.

NOT_A_CARD context words include 'trade', 'strategy', 'backtest', 'position', 'bot' (which matches 'both') -- the very words that introduce a recommended card -- so a 404 card introduced by them is dropped and the check passes.
judge() sets result = expected_pnl or 0; with proceeds present and unrealized_pnl absent a loss is treated as 0 and the P&L half is waived -- passes though total_pnl never moved.
requires an event-cards/positions URL whenever the scope mentions event cards, including how == 'counted'; a summary that counts them (nothing excluded) FAILS (#83).
when every tool the answer calls is unserved or has an unreadable schema, nothing is measured yet it PASSES with 'every one of the N tool(s) declares parameters'.
a failure counts as refusal only if it matches REFUSED_FOR_AUTH/NOT_SERVED; 'Login required', 'Sign in to access', 'missing credentials' are classed failed_on_its_own_terms and the check PASSES.
'the host list is exactly theirs' is asserted by a substring of cmd_enter's source; frozenset({"cymetica.com"}) | EXTRA, or the literal in a comment, stays green.
_tests_the_gate accepts any if whose test calls may_write_to_vendor(), either polarity; `if not may_write_to_vendor(): post` and `if may_write_to_vendor(): return` then post read as gated.
FAKE_KEY matches SECRET_PATTERNS so value redaction strips it everywhere; removing x-api-key or authorization from SECRET_HEADERS stays green.
code_dirty_after is porcelain at session end and HEAD is sampled only at start, so edit-and-commit mid-run stays V; the writer is untested (deleting it leaves the test green).
asserts only the 13 hard-coded rule ids; cloned_bots.fund moves money, has neither floor, and is not in `must`.
